scripts.start: npm run dev:check-port && concurrently "npm run dev:watch:params" "parcel serve index.html drops/index.html exchange/index.html --open --port 4000"
scripts.build:pages:prod: npm run dropparams:json && npm run clean:cache && npm run clean:prod && parcel build webflow/home.js webflow/drops.js webflow/exchange.js --dist-dir dist/prod --public-url ./ --no-content-hash --no-scope-hoist
scripts.build:pages:staging: npm run dropparams:json && npm run clean:cache && npm run clean:staging && parcel build webflow/home.js webflow/drops.js webflow/exchange.js --dist-dir dist/staging --public-url ./ --no-content-hash --no-scope-hoist
scripts.pages:sanity: npm run build:pages:staging && node scripts/sync-test-harness.mjs && node scripts/run-sanity-server.mjs
